messages:
taylor: Quick alert - SAST job failed in CI after an infra RBAC PR. Error shows KMS decrypt denied for scan artifact. Anyone on infra? cc @eng-infra
ana: Which key and SA?
taylor: Key=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/scans/cryptoKeys/sast-key, SA=scan-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Error: `PERMISSION_DENIED: not authorized to perform cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
maria: We recently tightened key bindings. PR infra#4720 removed a broad role and switched to narrower principals. Did that PR include scan-runner?
infra-bot: setIamPolicy event: actor=infra-automation@redwood-bots at 2026-04-02T09:12:03Z changed bindings on sast-key. Diff attached in infra repo.
ana: Can someone repro by impersonating the SA?
taylor: Reproduced locally: `gcloud kms decrypt --impersonate-service-account=scan-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` -> PERMISSION_DENIED
oncall: Short-term mitigation: add key-level binding `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for scan-runner and rerun CI. This is P1 until scans pass.
ci-bot: Re-triggered job=ci/sast id=503 (triggered by oncall).
ci-bot: Status: succeeded (sast id=503).
taylor: Scans green now.
maria: Post-incident: 1) add a pre-merge smoke test in infra repo that impersonates known CI SAs and runs a dry-run decrypt against keys they need; 2) add an alert rule: if scan-runner KMS PERMISSION_DENIED > 3 in 5m, page oncall + eng-infra; 3) confirm infra-automation changes require a deployment window or explicit approval when they touch scan keys.
sec-bot: Playbook ref: https://wiki.internal/redwood/sec/sdlc/kms-rotation-playbook. Added PM ticket SECURITY-819 to track preflight + alerting.
taylor: Thanks. Leaving notes for weekly sec sync and closing when SECURITY-819 is live.
